execution.ref: Launchpad smoke run 382c4276; fixed under LP-PROD-FIX-01 (.agent/decisions/2026-10-04-LP-PROD-FIX-01.md)
execution.description: Smoke run of the merged miner front end: Graphite and Carbon's agent campaigns on battery with no validator configured, then the Control Center's Tools tab and a restart.

expected: An agent's selected candidate the validator does not evaluate (evaluation_unavailable) is kept, and its campaign waits READY with that refusal and its next step through the Tools tab and a restart. Graphite's Planner corrects a refused argument after being told how.
observed: The candidate was kept, but the campaign settled INTERRUPTED with an empty interruptions.jsonl; opening the Tools tab left it RECONCILING, and a restart settled it INTERRUPTED again with campaign_interrupted over the evaluation_unavailable refusal. Every door that settles a campaign treated only agent none as waiting for its miner. Graphite's Planner sent strategy_json as the string "null" on kind=workspace, was refused workspace_recipe_forbidden with the JSON-null correction three ways, and never adapted.
keep: A refusal that keeps the candidate reaches the miner as last_refusal with its closed code and next step.
A run that raised stays INTERRUPTED, recorded in interruptions.jsonl.
A campaign frozen under an earlier rule replays and continues exactly as it was frozen; tolerance for a model's habit is a new frozen rule, never a silent change.
change: Every settling door asks one rule, waits_for_its_miner: no agent, or a retained candidate the validator did not evaluate.
New Graphite plans freeze carbon.autoresearch.argument-normalisation.v1, which reads a workspace strategy_json "null" as JSON null; practice still refuses it.

Test gap closed: journey scenarios 4 and 8d asserted the refusal code but not the campaign state, and no test opened the Tools tab on or restarted the Control Center over an agent campaign holding a retained candidate. They now do; the null-string refusal had a test only of the refusal itself, never of a model that does not correct it.
